# Eastbright Global

> Eastbright Global is a cross-border marketing agency focused on AI, SaaS and tech brands, helping them expand into international markets through localised marketing strategy, content marketing and creator partnerships. The team is based in Taiwan and Kuala Lumpur and serves Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau and Southeast Asia.

The website is available in Traditional Chinese (default) and English. Client names, results and methods are not published; they are discussed during a consultation. Project and retainer fees are quoted by scope.

## Services

- [Market Strategy Diagnostic](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#svc-1): competitor analysis, market selection and feasibility, positioning and local messaging strategy (市場策略診斷)
- [Social & Content Marketing](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#svc-2): Threads, Xiaohongshu (RED), Facebook, Instagram and TikTok community management, word-of-mouth, social listening and PR (海外整合行銷)
- [Meta / Google Advertising](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#svc-3): ad strategy, budget allocation, audience setup, creative testing, conversion tracking and reporting (Meta／Google 廣告投放)
- [Creator Partnerships](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#svc-4): screening and matching expert and tech creators (KOLs/KOCs), campaign planning, affiliate programmes and tracking (海外 KOL/KOC 網紅合作)
- [AI Enablement](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#ai): marketing workflow diagnostic, AI collaboration and review process, brand knowledge base, in-house training and adoption support (AI 企業賦能)

## Starter offer

- [Brand Check](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#diagnostic): USD 300, delivered in 7 working days. Covers market strategy and priority recommendations, competitor messaging, localisation risks, a recommended next step, red flags and a live online debrief. Fully credited towards a first project started within three months. (跨境品牌檢測)

## Markets

- Taiwan (GMT+8)
- Hong Kong and Macau (GMT+8)
- Southeast Asia, with a team in Kuala Lumpur (GMT+7 / +8)
- Multi-market coordination across the region

## Team

- Yvonne Wang: Co-Founder, Growth Marketing Consultant, based in Taiwan
- S Wang: Co-Founder, Cross-Border Market Consultant, based in Kuala Lumpur

- [關於 Eastbright Global](https://eastbrightglobal.com/about.html): Eastbright Global 是一家專注於跨境行銷的代理商，聚焦 AI、SaaS 與科技品牌，團隊分駐台灣與吉隆坡，服務台灣、港澳與東南亞市場。
- [AI Enablement](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/services/ai-enablement.html): Eastbright Global’s AI Enablement helps marketing teams build AI capability they can run on their own, through workflow diagnostics, AI collaboration and review processes, a brand knowledge base and in-house training.
- [AI 企業賦能](https://eastbrightglobal.com/services/ai-enablement.html): Eastbright Global 的 AI 企業賦能，透過行銷工作流診斷、團隊 AI 協作流程與審核機制、品牌知識庫建置與企業內訓陪跑，協助團隊建立能自主運作的 AI 行銷能力。
- [Creator Partnerships](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/services/creator-partnerships.html): Eastbright Global’s Creator Partnerships pair AI, SaaS and tech brands with expert and tech creators (KOLs/KOCs) from a network of 2,000+, using in-depth content to build trust and turn attention into customers.
- [海外 KOL/KOC 網紅合作](https://eastbrightglobal.com/services/creator-partnerships.html): Eastbright Global 的海外 KOL/KOC 網紅合作，為高決策門檻的 AI、SaaS 與科技產品，媒合 2,000+ 位知識型與科技型創作者，以深度內容建立信任並帶來實際用戶。
- [FAQ](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/faq.html): Eastbright Global FAQ: who the company is, services, what the Brand Check includes, timelines, results tracking and data protection.
- [常見問題](https://eastbrightglobal.com/faq.html): Eastbright Global 常見問題：公司介紹、服務範圍、跨境品牌檢測內容、合作時程、成效追蹤與資料保護。
- [Market Strategy Diagnostic](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/services/market-strategy.html): Eastbright Global’s Market Strategy Diagnostic helps AI, SaaS and tech brands choose markets, research competitor messaging and build localised brand strategy for Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau and Southeast Asia.
- [市場策略診斷](https://eastbrightglobal.com/services/market-strategy.html): Eastbright Global 的市場策略診斷，協助 AI、SaaS 與科技品牌完成市場選擇、競品溝通語言調研與在地化品牌策略，找出進入台灣、港澳與東南亞的差異化切角。
- [Meta / Google Advertising](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/services/performance-ads.html): Eastbright Global’s Meta / Google Advertising runs strategy, targeting, creative and tracking in-house, using AI to test creative variants fast so AI, SaaS and tech brands spend on measurable results.
- [Meta／Google 廣告投放](https://eastbrightglobal.com/services/performance-ads.html): Eastbright Global 的 Meta／Google 廣告投放，從策略、受眾、素材到轉換追蹤一手操盤，以 AI 快速產出多版素材測試，協助 AI、SaaS 與科技品牌把預算對準可衡量的成果。
- [Social & Content Marketing](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/services/social-content-marketing.html): Eastbright Global’s Social & Content Marketing builds localised content and word-of-mouth on Threads, Xiaohongshu (RED), Facebook, Instagram and TikTok so AI, SaaS and tech brands get seen, talked about and chosen.
- [海外整合行銷](https://eastbrightglobal.com/services/social-content-marketing.html): Eastbright Global 的海外整合行銷，以 Threads、小紅書、Facebook、Instagram、TikTok 的在地社群內容與口碑佈局，協助 AI、SaaS 與科技品牌在目標市場被看見、被討論、被選擇。

- [AI Makes Marketing Output Cheap. Why Does Judgement Become More Valuable?](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/blog/ai-output-cheap-judgement-valuable.html): When every team can produce ten creative versions a day, the bottleneck moves from production to deciding which version to run. Here is how marketing teams keep judgement strong. (Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/ai-output-cheap-judgement-valuable.en.md)
- [AI 讓行銷產出變便宜，為什麼判斷反而變得更有價值？](https://eastbrightglobal.com/blog/ai-output-cheap-judgement-valuable.html): 當每個團隊都能一天產出十版素材，瓶頸就從產能移到「哪一版該投」。本文說明行銷團隊如何在導入 AI 時守住判斷力。 (Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/ai-output-cheap-judgement-valuable.zh.md)
- [How Should Foreign Brands Start When Entering Taiwan?](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/blog/entering-taiwan-where-to-start.html): Start by confirming Taiwan is the right first market, then localise into Taiwan’s own language, platforms and labelling rules before you scale spend. (Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/entering-taiwan-where-to-start.en.md)
- [外國品牌進入台灣市場，該從哪裡開始？](https://eastbrightglobal.com/blog/entering-taiwan-where-to-start.html): 先確認台灣是不是現階段該進的市場，再依台灣的語言、平台與標示規定做在地化，小規模測試後才放大預算。 (Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/entering-taiwan-where-to-start.zh.md)
- [How Is Entering Hong Kong and Macau Different from Entering Taiwan?](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/blog/hong-kong-macau-vs-taiwan.html): Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan all use Traditional Chinese, but they differ in official languages, platforms and market size. Here is what changes for brands. (Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/hong-kong-macau-vs-taiwan.en.md)
- [進入港澳市場，和進入台灣有什麼不同？](https://eastbrightglobal.com/blog/hong-kong-macau-vs-taiwan.html): 港澳與台灣都使用繁體中文，但正式語文、主流平台與市場規模都不同。本文整理品牌進入港澳時需要調整的地方。 (Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/hong-kong-macau-vs-taiwan.zh.md)
- [Cross-Border Marketing: What Carries Over to a New Market, and What Must Be Rebuilt?](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/blog/what-carries-over-what-to-rebuild.html): A product’s value proposition usually carries over between markets; its messaging, channels and creators almost always need rebuilding. Here is where the line sits. (Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/what-carries-over-what-to-rebuild.en.md)
- [跨境行銷，什麼能沿用到新市場、什麼必須重做？](https://eastbrightglobal.com/blog/what-carries-over-what-to-rebuild.html): 產品的價值主張通常能跨市場沿用，溝通語彙、通路與創作者則幾乎都要重做。本文說明兩者的界線在哪裡。 (Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/what-carries-over-what-to-rebuild.zh.md)
- [Going Global: Which Asian Market Should a Brand Enter First?](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/blog/which-asian-market-first.html): The right first market in Asia is the one where demand, price, channels and your ability to operate line up, not the biggest one. Here is how to rank the options. (Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/which-asian-market-first.en.md)
- [品牌出海，該先進哪一個亞洲市場？](https://eastbrightglobal.com/blog/which-asian-market-first.html): 亞洲第一個市場該選的是需求、價格、通路與營運能力都對得上的市場，而不是規模最大的市場。本文整理比較方式與判斷條件。 (Markdown: https://eastbrightglobal.com/content/blog/which-asian-market-first.zh.md)
